acceptance: Crate aipo-hir implemented with High-Level IR data structures representing desugared syntax.
Lowering pass for trailing blocks: convert callee(args) do params ... end into callee(args, FunctionLiteral).
Lowering pass for pipeline: convert a |> f(b) into f(a, b).
Lowering pass for comparison ellipses: expand a < b < c / x >= 0 and <= 100 with temporary synthetic bindings.
Lowering pass for binding destructuring: expand [a, b] and {x, y} into indexed/property bindings.
Semantics and source span preservation verified through automated unit tests.
Zero unsafe code (unsafe_code = 'forbid') and quality gates clean.
constraints: Preserve source spans on all lowered and synthesized nodes.

evidence.description: cargo test -p aipo-hir passed with 4 automated tests verifying trailing block lowering to closure argument, pipeline desugaring into direct call, array destructuring into synthetic indexed bindings, and struct destructuring into property projections

non_goals: Semantic type checking or scope resolution (reserved for S5 aipo-sema).
objective: Implement aipo-hir with semantics-preserving lowering from AST to HIR
title: HIR Lowering: Desugaring trailing blocks, pipelines, destructuring, and comparison ellipses
